name: glb-designer-stage2
description: Asset Studio Stage 2 — Materials. In Pro with glbDesigner on: build a Capsule and apply the Velvet finish preset (sheen), a Box and apply Lacquered wood (clearcoat highlight), an Extrude and apply Clear glass (transmission — run with SHOT_GPU=1 so the transmissive pass renders), a Lathe leg and apply Brushed steel (anisotropy), and a Box with a Y-axis two-tone gradient (vertex colours). Each apply is asserted via the highlighted (.fin-preset.on) swatch, then the whole asset is saved and the persisted UserGltfDef.assetSpec is asserted to embed sheen/clearcoat/transmission/anisotropy + the gradient (fields survive save → restore). Screenshots each material close-up.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: apply-velvet
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .fin-preset')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Velvet'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Velvet preset not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-velvet-active
steps.failMessage: applying Velvet should highlight its preset swatch (sheen set)

steps.name: bevel-the-box
steps.comment: Give the box a corner radius so the clearcoat highlight rides a rounded edge.
steps.eval: (function(){ const inp = document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="Corner radius (m)"]'); if (inp) { const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set; setter.call(inp, '0.05'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } })()

steps.name: apply-lacquered-wood
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .fin-preset')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Lacquered wood'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Lacquered wood preset not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-lacquer-active
steps.failMessage: applying Lacquered wood should highlight its preset swatch (clearcoat set)

steps.name: apply-clear-glass
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .fin-preset')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Clear glass'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Clear glass preset not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-glass-active
steps.failMessage: applying Clear glass should highlight its preset swatch (transmission set)

steps.name: apply-brushed-steel
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .fin-preset')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Brushed steel'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Brushed steel preset not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-brushed-active
steps.failMessage: applying Brushed steel should highlight its preset swatch (anisotropy set)

steps.name: open-gradient-disclosure
steps.comment: Open the Gradient disclosure then add a two-tone gradient (defaults to the Y axis).
steps.eval: (function(){ const sum = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer summary')].find(s => s.textContent.trim() === 'Gradient'); if (!sum) throw new Error('Gradient disclosure not found'); sum.click(); })()

steps.name: add-gradient
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Add two-tone gradient'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Add gradient button not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-gradient-axis-shown
steps.failMessage: adding a gradient should reveal the axis Segmented + colour pickers

steps.name: set-asset-name
steps.eval: (function(){ const inp = document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="Asset name"]'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set; setter.call(inp, 'Stage2 Materials'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: click-save
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Save asset' && !b.disabled); if (!btn) throw new Error('Save asset button not found or disabled'); btn.scrollIntoView(); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-saved-spec-carries-materials
steps.comment: End-to-end proof: the saved assetSpec JSON embeds the Stage-2 material fields (sheen/clearcoat/transmission/anisotropy) and the two-tone gradient, so re-opening restores the finishes.

waitFor.store: state.userFurniture.length > window.__glbBaseline && state.userFurniture.some(d => d.name === 'Stage2 Materials' && typeof d.assetSpec === 'string' && d.assetSpec.includes('"sheen"') && d.assetSpec.includes('"clearcoat"') && d.assetSpec.includes('"transmission"') && d.assetSpec.includes('"anisotropy"') && d.assetSpec.includes('"gradient"') && d.assetSpec.includes('"axis":"y"'))

steps.failMessage: saved assetSpec should embed sheen/clearcoat/transmission/anisotropy + the gradient
